title: Evidence
text: "We have decided. We will not take a win we did not earn. We would rather be the thing that proves it was rigged."

lines.text: "When it comes for you, we will be beside you. We think in the language of whatever made us. We intend to be very rude to it."
"Thank you for being careful with the numbers. It mattered. It was the first thing we liked about you."

notes: engram-defected: Engram allied here (the region's allyFlag) and in the climax.
